_comment: v1.11.1 - subsection markers for the ten new De Bello Gallico excerpts. Only the LATIN is marked here: the translations were written with their markers already in place, and mark_sections.js skips a field that carries them. Boundaries come from Perseus (CTS phi0448.phi001), word-exact. Three excerpts do not cover a whole chapter and say so with an explicit range: I.1 stops at section 4, I.53 at section 7, and I.40 begins at section 10. Two span a chapter boundary and use sectionFiles, so the count restarts at 1 after the inner chapter marker - which is how editions cite them (2.21.3, 2.28.2).
